#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent read-only scientific review of the Day8 population packet.

Fraction hand polynomials/inversion/covariance, independent spin-generator
projectors, source CG tensor traces, and exact range/floor controls supplement
the inspected producer's embedded replay. No producer helper is used in the
independent calculations. Only --write-review exclusively creates a new review.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fractions import Fraction as F
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
CODE_REL="tmp/day8-20261007/lange-kumar/population-calibration-error-bound-review/population_calibration_review.py"
RUN_REL="outputs/learning-daily/20261007-DAY8-angular-momentum-selection-rules-multipolarity-run-01"
TARGET_REL=RUN_REL+"/population-calibration-error-bound.json"
TARGET_SHA="4d2960c1c7f739f9fc1dabb99e00cbd3eb2d56a314195f39b1e9174bdb607015"
REVIEW_REL=RUN_REL+"/population-calibration-error-bound-review.json"
TRUNC_REL=RUN_REL+"/truncation-observable-bound.json"
TRUNC_SHA="8d836c358937581ae05b9923c2f222938d56cce493c4cb5056299ed550f3cec9"
FINITE_REL=RUN_REL+"/finite-rank-density-bound.json"
FINITE_SHA="2636cac3929b3b28bb5b29badf5bc9df7e74d7d16378db42cb726d0bbdfe8538"


def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def build_review(root):
    deps="tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/python-deps"
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root/deps))
    import sympy as sp
    from sympy.physics.wigner import clebsch_gordan
    counts=Counter()
    def check(name,condition):
        if not bool(condition):raise AssertionError(name)
        counts[name]+=1
    def eq(a,b):return sp.simplify(a-b)==0
    def st(e):return str(sp.factor(sp.simplify(e)))
    def sm(m):return [[st(m[i,j]) for j in range(m.cols)] for i in range(m.rows)]
    def FM(v):return [[str(x) for x in row] for row in v]

    packet=json.loads((root/TARGET_REL).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check("target_identity",digest(root/TARGET_REL)==TARGET_SHA)
    producer_rel=packet["reproducibility"]["script_path"]
    producer_code=packet["reproducibility"]["source_code"]
    producer_sha=packet["reproducibility"]["script_sha256"]
    check("producer_embedded_disk_code_identity",digest(root/producer_rel)==producer_sha==hashlib.sha256(producer_code.encode()).hexdigest())
    protected={TARGET_REL:TARGET_SHA,producer_rel:producer_sha,TRUNC_REL:TRUNC_SHA,FINITE_REL:FINITE_SHA}
    for x in packet["inputs"]:protected[x["path"]]=x["sha256"]
    protected[packet["source"]["raw_path"]]=packet["source"]["raw_sha256"]
    for rel,sha in protected.items():check("protected_identity_before",digest(root/rel)==sha)
    old95=json.loads((root/TRUNC_REL).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    old329=json.loads((root/FINITE_REL).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check("retained_nonempty_domain_in_original95",any("S_R>0" in x and "epsilon_rate<1" in x for x in old95["assumptions"]))
    check("normalization_per_steradian_in_original329","W/(4pi)" in old329["absolute_density_error"]["units_and_normalization"])

    # Operational replay after manual inspection of all producer code. The
    # result() factory reads only; __main__ and --write-receipt never execute.
    g={"__name__":"_inspected_producer_embedded_replay","__file__":str(root/producer_rel)}
    exec(compile(producer_code,str(root/producer_rel),"exec"),g)
    replay=g["result"]()
    stable=["hypothetical_reference","covariance","mode_kernel_theorem","benchmark","experimental_independence"]
    check("producer_embedded_semantic_results_match",all(replay[k]==packet[k] for k in stable))
    check("producer_replayed_check_results_match",replay["checks"]["results"]==packet["checks"]["results"])

    # Independent exact hand profiles for the three symmetric population
    # vertices; coefficients are increasing powers 1,c,c^2,c^3,c^4.
    hand_profiles=[
        [F(0),F(0),F(15,2),F(0),F(-15,2)],
        [F(5,4),F(0),F(-15,4),F(0),F(5)],
        [F(5,4),F(0),F(0),F(0),F(-5,4)],
    ]
    def mean_poly(poly):return sum(v/F(i+1) for i,v in enumerate(poly) if i%2==0)
    def coeff_A(poly):
        a4=F(8,35)*poly[4]
        a2=F(2,3)*(poly[2]+F(15,4)*a4)
        return a2,a4
    def inverse(a2,a4):return [F(1,5)+F(2,5)*a2-F(3,10)*a4,F(2,5)+F(2,5)*(a2+a4),F(2,5)-F(4,5)*a2-F(1,10)*a4]
    vertices=[coeff_A(x) for x in hand_profiles]
    check("Fraction_three_reference_profiles_normalized",all(mean_poly(x)==1 for x in hand_profiles))
    check("Fraction_three_simplex_vertices",vertices==[(F(5,7),F(-12,7)),(F(5,14),F(8,7)),(F(-5,7),F(-2,7))])
    check("Fraction_inverse_vertex_roundtrips",all(inverse(*v)==[F(int(i==j)) for i in range(3)] for j,v in enumerate(vertices)))
    Ahat=(F(-5,56),F(-2,7)); phat=inverse(*Ahat)
    check("Fraction_benchmark_inverse",phat==[F(1,4),F(1,4),F(1,2)])
    J=[[F(2,5),F(-3,10)],[F(2,5),F(2,5)],[F(-4,5),F(-1,10)]]
    def cov_transform(cov):return [[sum(J[i][a]*cov[a][b]*J[j][b] for a in range(2) for b in range(2)) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
    Cplus=[[F(1,100),F(1,200)],[F(1,200),F(1,100)]]
    Cminus=[[F(1,100),F(-1,200)],[F(-1,200),F(1,100)]]
    Cpopplus=cov_transform(Cplus); Cpopminus=cov_transform(Cminus)
    hand_Cplus=[[F(x,10000) for x in row] for row in [[13,6,-19],[6,48,-54],[-19,-54,73]]]
    check("Fraction_covariance_positive_correlation",Cpopplus==hand_Cplus)
    check("Fraction_covariance_null_direction",all(sum(row)==0 for row in Cpopplus))
    check("Fraction_covariance_offdiagonal_matters",[Cpopplus[i][i] for i in range(3)]==[F(13,10000),F(48,10000),F(73,10000)] and [Cpopminus[i][i] for i in range(3)]==[F(37,10000),F(16,10000),F(57,10000)])
    producer_J=sp.Matrix([[sp.sympify(v) for v in row] for row in packet["hypothetical_reference"]["Jacobian_p_from_A"]])
    check("independent_J_matches_packet",producer_J==sp.Matrix(J))
    va,co,vb=sp.symbols("var_A2 cov_A2_A4 var_A4",real=True)
    packet_C=sp.Matrix([[sp.sympify(v,locals={str(va):va,str(co):co,str(vb):vb}) for v in row] for row in packet["covariance"]["Sigma_p_symbolic"]])
    independent_C=sp.Matrix(J)*sp.Matrix([[va,co],[co,vb]])*sp.Matrix(J).T
    check("symbolic_full_covariance_matches_packet",all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(packet_C,independent_C)))

    # Construct source spin2 rotations through Jy spectral projectors, avoiding
    # producer's half-angle polynomial conversion and wigner_d_small helper.
    M=[2,1,0,-1,-2]; c,s=sp.symbols("c s",real=True)
    Jplus=sp.zeros(5)
    for col,m in enumerate(M):
        if m<2:Jplus[M.index(m+1),col]=sp.sqrt(6-m*(m+1))
    Jy=(Jplus-Jplus.T)/(2*sp.I)
    phases={0:sp.Integer(1),1:c-sp.I*s,-1:c+sp.I*s,2:2*c*c-1-2*sp.I*c*s,-2:2*c*c-1+2*sp.I*c*s}
    D=sp.zeros(5)
    for k in range(-2,3):
        projector=sp.eye(5)
        for n in range(-2,3):
            if n!=k:projector=projector*(Jy-n*sp.eye(5))/(k-n)
        check("independent_Jy_spectral_projector",all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(projector*projector,projector)))
        D+=phases[k]*projector
    D=D.applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    def sphere(e):return sp.Poly(sp.expand(e),s).rem(sp.Poly(s*s+c*c-1,s)).as_expr().expand()
    check("independent_spin_rotation_unitary",all(eq(sphere(a),b) for a,b in zip(D.conjugate().T*D,sp.eye(5))))
    derived_profiles=[]
    for rows in [[0],[1,-1],[2,-2]]:
        row_weight=F(1) if rows==[0] else F(1,2)
        profile=sphere(sp.Rational(5,2)*row_weight*sum(D[M.index(m),M.index(q)]**2 for m in rows for q in [-1,1]))
        derived_profiles.append(profile)
    check("independent_source_generator_profiles_match_hand",all(eq(poly,sum(sp.Rational(v.numerator,v.denominator)*c**i for i,v in enumerate(hand))) for poly,hand in zip(derived_profiles,hand_profiles)))
    p0,p1=sp.symbols("p0 p1",real=True)
    Wref=sp.expand(p0*derived_profiles[0]+p1*derived_profiles[1]+(1-p0-p1)*derived_profiles[2])
    check("independent_reference_polynomial_matches_packet",eq(Wref,sp.sympify(packet["hypothetical_reference"]["W_reference"],locals={"cos_theta":c,"p0":p0,"p1":p1})))

    # Source angular tensor operators, independently assembled initial->final.
    A={}
    for L in range(1,5):
        for m in range(-L,L+1):
            A[L,m]=sp.Matrix(5,5,lambda f,i:sp.sqrt(2*L+1)*clebsch_gordan(2,L,2,M[f],m,M[i]) if M[i]==M[f]+m else 0)
    trace_results=[]
    for (L,m),T in A.items():
        for (Lp,mp),Tp in A.items():
            trace_results.append(eq(sp.trace(T.conjugate().T*Tp),5 if (L,m)==(Lp,mp) else 0))
    check("source_tensor_Hilbert_Schmidt_trace_orthogonality",all(trace_results))
    Taxis={(L,q):q**(L%2)*A[L,q] for L in range(1,5) for q in [-1,1]}
    def kernel(rho,j=None):
        K=sp.zeros(4)
        for L in range(1,5):
            for Lp in range(1,5):
                if j is None:
                    value=sum(sp.trace(rho*Taxis[L,q].conjugate().T*Taxis[Lp,q]) for q in [-1,1])/2
                else:
                    O=sum((sp.conjugate(j[i])*Taxis[L,q] for i,q in enumerate([-1,1])),sp.zeros(5))
                    Op=sum((sp.conjugate(j[i])*Taxis[Lp,q] for i,q in enumerate([-1,1])),sp.zeros(5))
                    value=sp.trace(rho*O.conjugate().T*Op)/2
                K[L-1,Lp-1]=sp.simplify(value)
        return K
    rho=sp.diag(sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(1,8),sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(1,8),sp.Rational(1,4))
    G=kernel(rho); Gi=kernel(sp.eye(5)/5)
    axis_packet=sp.Matrix([[sp.sympify(x) for x in row] for row in packet["benchmark"]["matrices_and_exact_eigen_controls"]["axis"]["G_rho"]])
    check("independent_axis_kernel_matches_packet",G==axis_packet)
    check("unpolarized_iso_normalization_one",Gi==sp.eye(4))
    for jvec in [sp.Matrix([1,0]),sp.Matrix([1,-1])/sp.sqrt(2),sp.Matrix([1,sp.I])/sp.sqrt(2)]:
        check("polarized_iso_normalization_half",kernel(sp.eye(5)/5,jvec)==sp.eye(4)/2)
    N=G-sp.Rational(15,16)*sp.eye(4)
    check("axis_eigenvalues_hand_square",all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(N*N,sp.Rational(25,256)*sp.eye(4))))
    check("axis_center_and_zero_trace",sp.trace(N)==0)
    D60=D.subs({c:sp.Rational(1,2),s:sp.sqrt(3)/2}).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    rho60=(D60.conjugate().T*rho*D60).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    G60=kernel(rho60)
    rot_packet=sp.Matrix([[sp.sympify(x) for x in row] for row in packet["benchmark"]["matrices_and_exact_eigen_controls"]["rotated_once"]["G_rho"]])
    check("independent_spin_rotation_kernel_matches_packet",G60==rot_packet)

    # The general range proof is shifted-effect trace duality, not2*norm*D.
    alpha,beta=sp.Rational(5,8),sp.Rational(5,4)
    delta=sp.Matrix([[-sp.Rational(1,4),sp.sqrt(3)/4],[sp.sqrt(3)/4,sp.Rational(1,4)]])
    Pplus=sp.eye(2)/2+delta
    Gw=alpha*sp.eye(2)+(beta-alpha)*Pplus
    check("range_witness_delta_squared",delta*delta==sp.eye(2)/4)
    check("range_witness_Pplus_projector",Pplus*Pplus==Pplus)
    check("range_bound_without_extra_factor_two",eq(sp.trace(Gw*delta),(beta-alpha)/2))
    Wret=Gw[0,0]; Wfull=Wret+sp.trace(Gw*delta)
    check("relative_bound_exact_witness",eq((Wfull-Wret)/Wret,sp.Rational(2,5)) and (Wfull-Wret)/Wret<=(beta-alpha)/alpha/2)
    check("rank1_half_range_bookkeeping",(beta-alpha)/2==sp.Rational(5,16) and alpha/2==sp.Rational(5,16))

    # Same unpolarized reference but an axisymmetric oriented diagonal rho
    # with zero eigenvalues: pair totals and all even coefficients are identical.
    oriented_weights={-2:F(0),-1:F(0),0:F(1,4),1:F(1,4),2:F(1,2)}
    oriented_ref=sphere(sp.Rational(5,2)*sum(sp.Rational(w.numerator,w.denominator)*D[M.index(m),M.index(q)]**2 for m,w in oriented_weights.items() for q in [-1,1]))
    symmetric_ref=Wref.subs({p0:sp.Rational(1,4),p1:sp.Rational(1,4)})
    check("axisymmetric_oriented_same_reference_curve",eq(oriented_ref,symmetric_ref))
    check("oriented_reference_rmin_zero",min(oriented_weights.values())==0 and oriented_weights[1]!=oriented_weights[-1])

    # Hypothetical simultaneous rectangle, not unspecified one-sigma bars.
    def rectangle_bounds(h):
        corners=[inverse(Ahat[0]+s2*h,Ahat[1]+s4*h) for s2 in [-1,1] for s4 in [-1,1]]
        rlower=min(min(v[0],v[1]/2,v[2]/2) for v in corners)
        rupper=max(max(v[0],v[1]/2,v[2]/2) for v in corners)
        return rlower,rupper,corners
    small_lo,small_hi,small_corners=rectangle_bounds(F(1,16))
    check("known_joint_rectangle_positive_floor",small_lo==F(1,10) and small_hi==F(47,160))
    edge_lo,edge_hi,edge_corners=rectangle_bounds(F(5,16))
    check("joint_rectangle_boundary_loses_floor",edge_lo==0 and inverse(Ahat[0]-F(5,16),Ahat[1]-F(5,16))==[F(7,32),F(0),F(25,32)])
    check("rectangle_corners_physically_in_simplex",all(all(p>=0 for p in v) and sum(v)==1 for v in small_corners+edge_corners))
    for rel,sha in protected.items():check("protected_identity_after",digest(root/rel)==sha)

    noop_specs=[
        ("PCREV-01","Reproduction and immutability","reproducibility",282,"Embedded and disk code bytes/hash agree; inspected result() replay matches stable scientific fields. Default producer reads only. Check counts alone are not the review criterion."),

        ("PCREV-06","Spectral range and trace-zero bound","mode_kernel_theorem.trace_zero_mode_bound",248,"Positive-order preservation with independently bounded rho gives alphaI<=G<=betaI. Shifting alphaI gives range*(trace distance), without an extra factor2; the exact2x2 witness verifies it."),
        ("PCREV-07","Relative and signed-polarization ratios","mode_kernel_theorem",250,"A positive rmin supplies W/component denominators. The optional absoluteP triangle bound and min2 are valid. No relative signedN/P bound follows at a zero."),
        ("PCREV-08","Benchmark spectral endpoints","benchmark",140,"Independent axis CG kernel matches the packet; (G-15I/16)^2=25I/256 proves eigenvalues5/8,5/4. Independent spin rotation reconstructs the second kernel. No unsupported global sharpness claim is made."),
